verdict.rationale: Folk documents its own person-enrichment capability: an Enrich people endpoint for up to 500 people, a `person_enrichment.finished` webhook, and "Contact enrichment" listed as a plan feature. However, the evidence only shows on-request enrichment of people, not automatic enrichment of companies. Missing for 10: company-record enrichment, firmographic data fields, automatic enrichment without an explicit request, documentation of which contact fields get enriched, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data

citations.quote: Request an enrichment of up to 500 people with Enrich people.
subscribe a webhook to the `person_enrichment.finished` event
